## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: unit tests written and passing (banned-words portion)

## Description
Add failing tests for `find_banned_words(text, banned_set) -> list[str]`. Cases: case-insensitive matching, empty result for no matches, multi-match preserves first-occurrence order.

## Given/When/Then
Given banned_set={'utilize','leverage'} and text='Please Utilize the portal and leverage data.'; When find_banned_words(text, banned_set) is invoked; Then it returns ['utilize','leverage'] (lowercased, in order of appearance).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED test fails with ImportError
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k find_banned_words 2>&1 | grep -E '(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|AttributeError)' || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py: Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
